description: This file declares the CommandBufferHelper class, which manages GPU command buffers, textures, and shared images within the media GPU component. It includes methods for synchronization, texture management, and context handling, and references various GPU and GL classes.

classes.name: CommandBufferHelper
classes.description: A ref-counted class that manages GPU command buffers, textures, and shared images, providing synchronization and context management functionalities.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new CommandBufferHelper instance associated with a given GPU command buffer stub.

methods.name: WaitForSyncToken
methods.description: Waits for a GPU sync token to be signaled, then executes a callback.

methods.name: GetSharedImageStub
methods.description: Returns the shared image stub interface.

methods.name: GetDXGISharedHandleManager
methods.description: Returns the DXGI shared handle manager (Windows only).

methods.name: HasStub
methods.description: Checks if the command buffer stub has been destroyed.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a shared image backing and returns a reference.

methods.name: GetTexture
methods.description: Retrieves a GPU texture by service ID.

methods.name: CreateTexture
methods.description: Creates a new GPU texture with specified parameters.

methods.name: DestroyTexture
methods.description: Destroys a GPU texture by service ID.

methods.name: SetCleared
methods.description: Sets the cleared flag on a texture.

methods.name: BindDecoderManagedImage
methods.description: Binds a decoder-managed image to a texture (Windows and Apple).

methods.name: BindClientManagedImage
methods.description: Binds a client-managed image to a texture (other platforms).

methods.name: AddWillDestroyStubCB
methods.description: Adds a callback to be invoked when the stub is destroyed.

methods.name: IsPassthrough
methods.description: Returns whether the command buffer is passthrough.
